description:
Returns up to 10 stocks with the highest TipRanks Smart Score (perfect 10 / Outperform) in one market.

    Args:
        num: Number of results; the feed returns at most 10 whatever this asks
        sector: Keeps the rows of that top-10 list in this sector, or empty for all
        country: 'US', 'Canada', 'UK', 'Germany', 'Spain', 'Australia', 'Singapore',
                 'HongKong', 'Global'; any other country returns no_match.
                 NOTE: UK tickers use GB: prefix but the country param is 'UK'.

country.description: 'US','Canada','UK','Germany','Spain','Australia','Singapore','HongKong', or 'Global' (default: US); these are the only markets with a list, and any other country returns no_match. UK tickers are returned with a 'GB:' prefix but the country value is still 'UK'.
country.title: Country

sector.description: Keeps only the rows of the market's top-10 list in this sector: financial, healthcare, consumerdefensive, consumercyclical, utilities, basicmaterials, technology, industrials, energy, communicationservices, realestate (default: all sectors). The list is ranked across all sectors, so a sector often keeps few rows or none.
sector.title: Sector

name: get_top_smart_score_stocks
